correctness.rationale: Two independent derivations give the exact dimensionless mean: a backward Feynman–Kac transform followed by a renewal reset reduction, and direct two-region mean backward equations. For all s>=0 and w>0 the entire-series part has positive second derivative; the sine-hyperbolic product yields Q2/Q1^2<=2/5 and G_prime^2/(G G_doubleprime)<=5/3, so the remaining term has strictly positive second derivative by completing the square. Coercivity gives existence and strict convexity gives uniqueness. The cubic slope and analytic implicit-function theorem give the threshold and expansion. All boundaries, rates, and zero-reset continuity are covered. A standalone checker passed 5,325 finite diagnostics, not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: For feedback-reset search, whether an extra uninformed clock is helpful at fixed feedback strength is a natural protocol-design question. The work supplies an exact, dimensionless, and genuinely global phase boundary, excludes disconnected optima rather than reporting a local criterion, and quantifies critical rate and performance-gain scaling. The product-based curvature certificate is structural, not a textbook substitution or arbitrary slice.
